text:

Improvement
Quantify your Investment Fund work
Close
▾
Why this helps

Finance and analyst recruiters scan for quantified impact first. A bullet without a number reads as a responsibility, not an achievement, and gets skimmed past.

Current
Analyst, Smith Investment Fund. Researched stocks and presented ideas to the group.
Suggested
Smith Investment Fund Analyst, pitched 3 long equity ideas to a student investment committee; one was added to the fund's ~$250K book after a full DCF and comparable-company write-up.
